name: Midea Smart 50-Pint Dehumidifier with Built-in Pump (MAD50PS1AWT-C)
description: Selling a Midea Smart 50-Pint Dehumidifier with Built-in Pump (Model MAD50PS1AWT-C), originally purchased from [Costco](https://www.costco.com/p/-/midea-smart-50-pint-dehumidifier-with-built-in-pump/4000437929). This Energy Star certified unit removes up to 50 pints of moisture per day — plenty for a damp basement, large living space, or laundry room (rated for spaces up to 4,500 sq ft). It is Wi-Fi smart: control it from anywhere through the Midea SmartHome app, with Alexa and Google Assistant voice control, humidity target from 35%–85%, 2 fan speeds, 24-hour timer, and bucket-full alerts. Also features the MShield air ionizer (reduces odors, smoke, and gases), auto-restart after power outages, a washable/reusable filter, auto-defrost for cooler temperatures, four caster wheels, and side carry handles — so you can roll it wherever it is needed. **⚠️ Honest Disclosure — Built-in Pump Does NOT Work**: The headline feature — the internal condensate pump that continuously drains water upward to a sink or out a window — has mysteriously stopped functioning, so this unit CANNOT hose-drain itself anymore. Dehumidification, the display, and the smart app features all work perfectly; you simply empty the 6.34-quart side-access bucket manually (the splash-guard lid keeps spills to a minimum). It is priced accordingly as a manual-emptying 50-pint smart dehumidifier. This is why the price is well below the Costco shelf price. From a cat-friendly apartment — the filter was cleaned and the exterior wiped down. It does NOT come with the original retail box or the drain hose kit, so local pickup buyers, please bring a vehicle with room for the unit.
meta_description: Midea Smart 50-Pint Dehumidifier (MAD50PS1AWT-C) for sale. Energy Star, Wi-Fi app control, up to 4,500 sq ft. Built-in pump not working — disclosed; priced accordingly.
name_zh: 美的 Midea 智能 50 品脱除湿机（带内置排水泵款 MAD50PS1AWT-C）
description_zh: 转让一台美的（Midea）智能 50 品脱除湿机（型号 MAD50PS1AWT-C），当初购于 [Costco](https://www.costco.com/p/-/midea-smart-50-pint-dehumidifier-with-built-in-pump/4000437929)。Energy Star 节能认证，每天最多可抽湿 50 品脱（约 25 升），额定覆盖面积高达 4,500 平方英尺，地下室、大客厅、洗衣房通通够用。支持 Wi-Fi 智能控制：手机下载 Midea SmartHome App 即可远程操控，兼容 Alexa 和 Google Assistant 语音指令；湿度目标 35%–85% 可调、两档风速、24 小时定时、水箱满提醒。还带 MShield 空气负离子净化（可除异味、烟味和气体）、断电自动重启、可水洗滤网、低温自动除霜、底部四个万向轮加侧面提手，推到哪里用哪里。**⚠️ 如实披露——内置排水泵已坏**：这款机子最大的卖点——内置冷凝水泵（可把水自动往上抽到水槽或窗外直排）——现在莫名其妙不能用了，无法再接管子自动排水。除湿功能、显示屏、App 智能功能全部正常，唯一区别是：需要手动倒水箱（侧面抽拉式 6.34 夸脱水箱，带防溅盖设计，倒水不容易洒）。所以价格也按“手动倒水的 50 品脱智能除湿机”来定，比 Costco 原价便宜非常多，请买家按此预期购买。家里养猫，出货前已清洗滤网并擦拭机身。**不附带原厂包装箱和排水管套件**，本地自提的买家请开一辆后备箱放得下的车来。
